New York, USA
Paris, France
London, England

To ensure that monarchies ruled all sovereign countries
To maintain international peace, encourage disarmament, and foster global cooperation
To collect taxes from all nations to fund global space travel

Collective Security
Appeasement
Isolationism

Because Switzerland refused to talk to any nation except the USA
The USA was the world's wealthiest power, leaving economic sanctions toothless without American trade support

Germany and the USSR (Soviet Russia)
Japan and Italy
Britain and France

The Council
The Permanent Court
The Assembly

2.question: Which smaller executive body met several times a year to resolve urgent crises, with permanent members holding a veto?
options: The Assembly
The Mandates Commission
The International Labour Organization
The Council
2.explanation: The Council held executive power, with permanent seats for Britain, France, Italy, and Japan.

Decisions required approval by the Pope
Decisions made exclusively by alphabetical lottery
The requirement for unanimous agreement (all members had to vote in favor)

The League awarded the islands to Finland with cultural guarantees for the Swedish population, accepted by both sides
The League ordered all inhabitants to abandon the islands
The islands were sold to Great Britain

It ordered the execution of both governments
